title: RT-qPCR for Detection of SARS-CoV-2 in Wastewater
author: David Findlay
materials: Defrost sufficient RT-qPCR reagents and refrigerate until ready to use.N.B. DO NOT REMOVE RT ENZYME FROM -20°C FREEZER UNTIL READY TO USE. MAINTAIN ON ICE AT ALL TIMES AND RETURN IMMEDIATELY AFTERWARDS.

DEFROST AND MAINTAIN REAGENTS ON ICE Reagent Volume (µl) per reaction (N) Per sample RT-qPCR reaction mix 10 35 RT enzyme 1 3.5 Primer/Probe mix 1.5 5.25 BSA 2 7 Nuclease-free water 0.5 1.75 Template 5 17.5 Total volume 20 70 The list containing primers and probes sequences and concentration can be found in the attached file below Primers_probes_list_SARS-CoV-2_RT-qPCR-WW.xlsx
Cover plate and transfer to sample addition cabinet
Cover and transfer to Template addition cabinet.
Highlight “Standard” wells and assign appropriate concentration values

steps.title: Prepare Workspace
steps.instruction: Clean and sterilize the work area to prevent contamination.

substeps.instruction: Clean all surfaces with RNase away or 10% v/v bleach solution.
Turn on UV lamps in the Master Mix preparation cabinet and Template addition cabinet for 20 minutes.
Ensure sufficient cooler blocks and/or ice baths are available for each workstation.

steps.title: Plan Reactions
steps.instruction: Complete the RT-qPCR Plate Worksheet to calculate the number of reactions (N) and the required volume of Master Mix (refer to Appendix 1).

steps.title: Prepare Controls and Samples
steps.instruction: Defrost the positive control and any required samples and maintain them on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Standard Curve Dilution Series
steps.instruction: Create a 1:10 dilution series covering 5 dilution points (50,000 to 5 copies per µl) using EURM Reference Material ssRNA fragments of SARS-CoV-2 (EURM019) and synthetic fragments of the ORF7 gene for PRRSv DNA standards.

substeps.instruction: In the positive template cabinet, label 5 tubes, add 225 µl of RNase-free water to each, and place on ice.
Transfer 25 µl from the stock solution into the labelled (5e+4) tube.
Mix and spin twice to ensure thorough homogenisation.
Repeat the transfer and mixing process until the dilution series is complete.
Store the series on ice until needed.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix
steps.instruction: Combine the master mix reagents (excluding template) in the Master Mix cabinet while working on ice.

substeps.instruction: Invert the mixture 5 times to mix.

steps.title: Load qPCR Plate
steps.instruction: Dispense reagents and samples into a 96-well PCR plate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 15 µl of master mix into each required well.
Add 5 µl of nuclease-free water to 'no template control' (NTC) wells and cap.
Add 5 µl of sample to appropriate wells and cap.
Add 5 µl of each positive control dilution series to appropriate wells and cap.

steps.title: Run qPCR Instrument
steps.instruction: Process the plate in the qPCR instrument using the specified setup and thermal profile.

substeps.instruction: Spin plate down at 1000 RCF for 1 minute.
Transfer the plate to the qPCR instrument, lower and lock the upper tray, and close the door.
In 'Plate setup', select all wells and assign them per the Plate Worksheet.
Choose relevant filters: N1 – FAM and ROX; E gene (optional) – HEX and ROX; PRRS – Cy5 and ROX.
Set the Thermal Profile: 55 ºC for 10 min (1 cycle), 95 ºC for 1 min (1 cycle), then 40 cycles of 95 ºC for 10 seconds and 55 ºC for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Save the run file to a PC and perform data interpretation.

substeps.instruction: Highlight all wells and assign ROX as the reference dye.
Highlight sample wells and assign sample identifiers.
Select the following columns for all wells: Well, Well Name, Well Type, Ct (dRn) or Cq (∆Rn), Quantity (copies), RSq (dRn) or R² (∆Rn), Slope (dRn), and Efficiency (%).
Check baseline threshold values (~0.03 FAM and ~0.1 Cy5).
Verify that NTC wells are negative (No Cq).
Verify Standard Curve criteria: R-Sq > 0.9, Slope (y) between -3.1 and -3.92, and Efficiency between 80 and 110%. Repeat analysis if parameters are exceeded.

steps.title: Report Results
steps.instruction: Export raw data to Excel to calculate gene copy equivalents per litre and report based on the following criteria:

substeps.instruction: Replicate mean > LoQ = Quantifiable Positive Result (e.g., 12345 gc/L)
Replicate mean > LoD but < LoQ = 'Positive (DNQ)'
Replicate mean < LoD = 'Weak Positive'
Both replicates produce No Cq = 'Negative'
